en: Colorized historic street view of a European city with a large Renaissance-style building on the left featuring a steep red-tile roof and a square clock tower topped by a small dome and cross. Further along the street are ornate buildings with Baroque and neo‑Gothic spires. The broad avenue has tram tracks with green electric trams, horse‑drawn carriages, and many pedestrians in late‑19th‑ to early‑20th‑century fashion. No printed caption or other text is visible on the front.
